THE WAGES BOARDS ORDINANCE NOTIFICATION
Wages Board for the Rubber (Including Tyre Manufacturing and Re- Building), Plastic and Petroleum Resin ProductsManufacturing Trade

IN accordance with the provisions of Section 28 of the Wages Boards Ordinance (Chapter 136) the Wages Board for theRubber (Including Tyre Manufacturing and Re-Building), Plastic and Petroleum Resin Products Manufacturing Trade herebynotifies that the Board by virtue of powers vested in it by Section 30 of the aforesaid Ordinance proposes to vary in the mannerset out in the schedule hereto, such decisions of the Board as are specified in that Schedule.
Objections to the aforesaid proposal will be received by the Chairman of the Board until 12.00 noon on 25th of May 2018.
Every such objection must be made in writting and must contain a statement of the grounds upon which such objection is taken.

A. WIMALAWEERA,Chairman,Wages Board for the Rubber (Including Tyre Manufacturingand Re- Building), Plastic and Petroleum Resin Products Manufacturing Trade.Department of LabourColombo 05.1st May, 2018
